content: Sara-burgwisad
Sara birga-dulanergwa-gakagugle-nikadgi (127) burgwisad.
Sara Canaán-yalagangi, Quiriat-Arba-neggweburgi burgwisad. Quiriat-Arbaʼde, Hebrónʼye bilebalid. Abraham Sara-burgwisadba nue-bosad, degine, nue-Sara-ebinsadii gusbalid.
Geb degine, Abraham Sara-burgwar-maid-obes nade gusad. Het-dulemarse naded.
Geb Abraham Het-dulemarga sogded: —Ar an bemar-abargine weginedsur-inigwele, anga wis be neg-uan manigi ukmala, adi, an-ome-mui agi an digegar.
Het-dulemar Abraham-abin sogdemalad:

—¡Dummad, bega an sogmardo! Ar Bab-Dummad anmar-abargine, dule-dummadga be-susad. Degisoggu, be-ome-mui anmar-neg-uan-bur-nuedgi be dige. Ar anmar-wargwensaar bega sogosulid: Melle be-ome-e-mui be anmar-neg-uangi digye.
Geb degine, Abraham gwisgusad, Het-dulemar-bukmalad-asabin dulluu imaksad.
Geb degi, amarga sogded: —Ar bemar wegi an-ome-burgwisad nue-digbi abegele, an bemarse wilesakwaa egisdo, an-nuggi bemar Zohar-machi-Efrónʼse egismar:
‘Anga, e-nainu-dikarba-akwasaila-ollor-siid, Macpelaʼye-nugad, manigi ukye.’ Ar e-mani-gargeguedba, an bennukoed. Ar degiir, geb an neg-uan wegi nikuoed.
Ar Het-dule-Efrón emar-abargi simosoggu, bela Het-dulemar, degi, dule-bela-neggweburse-ubomamaid e-itomalaga, Abraham-abin sogded:

—¡Dummad, degisuli! An-nainu, degine, akwasaila-ollor-siid binsa an bega ukoed, maniginsuli. An-sordamar-bukwad anmar-daksiid, amar-asabin an bega we-akwasaila-ollor-siid binsa uknaid. Agi be-ome-mui be dige.
Abrahamʼdi Het-dulemar-asabin gannar na dulluu imakded.
Abraham bela dulemar-e-itobukwad-abargi Efrón-abin sogded: —¡Bemar bela nue an-itogo! An bega soged, mani be sue. Nainu an bese bakoed. Geb a-sorba, an-ome-mui an digoed.
Geb degi, Efrón abin-sogded:
—Dummad, nue be an-itogo: Nainu-e-gargegued mani-dulataled-ilabake-aidikued-wilub (400) gargegued. Wegindi anmar na abin-abin imakosurmalad. Degisoggu, be-ome be dignado.
Abraham, Efrón Het-dulemar-abargi ega nainu-gargegued-sogsad nabir-itosad. Degisoggu, dule-ibmar-ukmalad-igar-maidba mani-dulataled-ilabake-aidikued-wilub (400) mie-mie bennuksad.
Weyobi, Mamre-dad-nakwedsik Efrón-nainu-Macpelaʼgi-naidi, Abrahamʼgadga gunonikid. A sogleged, nainu, akwasaila-ollor-siid, bela sapimar, Abrahamʼgadga gunoniye.
Het-dulemar, degi, dule-bela-neggweburgi-dogmamaid, nue-amar-daksii gusmarmogad.

Geb agine, Abraham akwasaila-ollor-siidgi e-ome-Sara-mui-digsa gusad. We akwasaila-ollor-dummad, Macpela-nainugi siid, Mamre-dad-nakwedsik. Mamre-neggweburde Hebrónʼye nugbalid, Mamre-neggwebur Canaán-yargi siid.
Weyob we-nainugi akwasaila-ollor-siid, Abrahamʼgadga gunonikid. We-nainude Het-dulemar Abrahamʼga manigi uksad, adi, Abraham we-nainu e-neg-uanga imakegar.
